name: Glebovka-Simferopol-Sevastopol Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: sponsor and concrete step: Russian plan 816-r item 141 is a territorial-planning list entry only; no named sponsor, no FEED/EPC award, permit or tender found; current build status unknown (a 2014 report said stage 3 of the second line was due in 2014, so it may be older and built)
researcher_notes: No existing GEM Ukraine row covers this trunk (47 existing rows checked for Simferopol, Sevastopol, Glebovka, Crimea). Russian federal plan 816-r annex 4 item 141 lists the third stage of the Glebovka-Simferopol-Sevastopol main gas pipeline: 102 km, 500 mm, 8.193 million cubic meters per day, running through Bakhchisaray, Saki and Simferopol districts to Sevastopol, to raise throughput from the Glebovka storage into the Crimean grid. Territory follows GEM naming rules: Crimea and Sevastopol are Ukraine. A 2014 neftegaz.ru report says stage 3 of the second Glebovka-Simferopol line was planned to finish in 2014, so stages 1 and 2 exist and stage 3 may already be built, but no source gives stage lengths, owner or dates. Stages 1 and 2 have no sourced length, so they are not stageable as rows. If later evidence names the sponsor (likely Chernomorneftegaz or Krymgazseti, an occupying-power operator, to be reported as builder only) and a concrete step, stage 3 as one row of 102 km. Do not duplicate the Kuban-Crimea line (krasnodar-krai-crimea) or the Dzhankoi-Simferopol-Sevastopol trunk. Values shown are what the plan states; tier medium, single source for the figures. Route not researched.
